zh: 某个值第一次和最后一次出现之间的所有位置，最终都必须和它是同一个值，所以这些位置上的值都要合并到一起。
把每个值的首末区间看成线段，互相重叠的线段连成块，每块最终必须合并成一种值；含 d 种值的块恰好需要 d−1 次操作。
先记录每个值最后出现的位置；从左往右扫描，维护当前块能延伸到的最远末位置，当前下标等于它时结束一个块；答案为不同值的个数减去块数。
en: Every position between the first and last occurrence of a value must end up holding the same value as it, so all values at those positions have to be merged together.
Treat each value's first-to-last range as a segment; overlapping segments chain into blocks, each block must end up as one value, and a block with d distinct values needs exactly d-1 operations.

Record each value's last occurrence; scan left to right keeping the farthest last position the current block reaches, and close a block when the index equals it; the answer is the number of distinct values minus the number of blocks.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Record the last occurrence of each value and scan to get the maximum number of independent contiguous intervals; the answer is the original number of distinct values minus the number of independent intervals.

## Proof of correctness

All positions between the first and last occurrence of a value must end up with the same value, so each connected block formed by mutually overlapping first-to-last intervals must be merged into one value. Scanning with the farthest last position finds exactly these blocks; a block containing d values needs at least d−1 merges, and replacing them one by one into the same value takes exactly d−1. Summing gives the number of distinct values minus the number of blocks.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
